purpose: Connect the already-implemented provider-neutral TemplateDefinition model to one normal Song consumer journey: let the artist save a bounded reusable Template into the canonical profile, inspect the saved semantic definition, and select it for the active Song without pretending that selection applies anything to a DAW or provider.

lineage.outcome: The artist can preserve and choose a reusable provider-neutral starting intent from the normal Song surface without binding that Template to Ableton, Logic, FL Studio, a provider, a plug-in, a track index or an execution route.
lineage.capability: Canonical provider-neutral Template library plus durable Song selection

why_now: Global reselection after PR #81 compared dependency-ready UX-01, DAW-00, AUDIO-01, AUDIO-02, SONG-01 and OPS-04 against canonical scope and current implementation. Audio already has a consumer-reachable exact-material Engineering Snapshot. The existing n0te2/templates.py and tests/core/test_templates.py prove the host-neutral Template object and pure capability planner, but the normal consumer shell contains no Template path and no durable Template library/selection. This is therefore a demonstrated connection gap rather than a missing Template model.

implementation_contract.authoring: one semantic role per consumer-created Template in this bounded increment; the underlying existing model remains multi-role capable
implementation_contract.identity: Template and role meaning contains no host/provider/candidate/track/DAW/plugin identity
implementation_contract.selection_history: append-only and durable; latest Song selection is current
implementation_contract.relaunch: saved Templates and Song selection survive Headquarters/shell relaunch
implementation_contract.authority: saving or selecting a Template grants no action authority and performs no provider, network, spend, publication or DAW mutation
implementation_contract.application_truth: consumer copy must state that selection remembers a reusable start only; actual application requires a later real Studio capability profile plus adapter execution contract

completion_proof: the active Song exposes one Templates card without adding Template domain logic to consumer_shell.py
the artist can save a one-role Template with family, name, intent, capability and role description through a protected consumer POST
the saved Template reconstructs exactly as existing TemplateDefinition/TemplateRole objects after relaunch
Templates are Artist/profile scoped and one profile cannot see another profile's saved definitions
the artist can select a saved Template for the active Song and the selection persists across relaunch
selection for one Song does not become selection for another Song
Template definitions and selection history are append-only and corrupt/inconsistent state fails visibly rather than silently empty
duplicate identical save is idempotent while conflicting reuse of the same immutable Template identity fails closed
consumer Host, Origin, CSRF, one-shot action and active-Song bindings are preserved for save/select actions
normal markup exposes human Template semantics but not internal profile, Song or selection identifiers
saving/selecting creates no OperationJournal execution and makes no DAW/provider/network call
visible copy does not claim FULL/PARTIAL/UNAVAILABLE application readiness because the consumer runtime does not yet own a real StudioCapabilityProfile
full regression and staged consumer smoke pass on Linux, Windows and macOS at the exact implementation head
non_scope: FULL/PARTIAL/UNAVAILABLE application readiness in the consumer shell
